history.zh: 1801年现代证券交易所成立；1986年英国金融“大爆炸”（Big Bang）改革实现去监管化；1995年创立AIM（另类投资市场）；2001年7月LSE本身成为在自己市场挂牌的公众公司；2007年10月与米兰证券交易所（Borsa Italiana）合并组成伦敦证券交易所集团（LSEG）；2009年收购MillenniumIT（现交易系统Millennium Exchange的技术基础）并取得泛欧交易平台Turquoise的多数股权；2013年取得清算所LCH集团的多数股权；2021年1月完成对数据商Refinitiv的全股份收购
history.en: The modern Stock Exchange was born in 1801; the UK market was deregulated in the 1986 'Big Bang'; AIM (Alternative Investment Market) was founded in 1995; in July 2001 London Stock Exchange became a public company listed on its own market; in October 2007 it merged with Milan's Borsa Italiana to form London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG); MillenniumIT was acquired in 2009 (the technology base for today's Millennium Exchange) alongside a majority stake in pan-European venue Turquoise; a majority stake in LCH Group was acquired in 2013; the all-share acquisition of Refinitiv completed in January 2021

监管"（如港交所）与"纯由外部机构监管"两种模式之外的第三种组合，与NYSE"交易所自身

foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 英国对上市公司股权收购不区分收购方国籍设置一般性外资持股比例上限，而是采用以国家安全为由的个案审查机制：《2021年国家安全与投资法》（National Security and Investment Act 2021, NSI Act）规定，收购方持股或表决权比例跨越25%/50%/75%三档门槛、且标的实体从事列明的17个「敏感领域」业务时须强制向政府申报；政府可批准、附条件批准，极端情形下可阻止或撤销交易；未经批准即完成的强制申报交易在法律上无效，收购方可能面临民事或刑事处罚
foreign_ownership_limit.en: The UK does not impose a general statutory cap on foreign ownership of listed shares differentiated by the acquirer's nationality; instead it applies a case-by-case national security review. Under the National Security and Investment Act 2021 (NSI Act), an acquirer crossing the 25%/50%/75% shareholding or voting-rights thresholds in a qualifying entity carrying on activities in one of 17 defined 'sensitive' sectors must notify the government; the government may clear the acquisition, impose conditions, or in rare cases block or unwind it. Completing a notifiable acquisition without approval renders it void and may expose the acquirer to civil or criminal penalties.
foreign_ownership_limit.detail:
NSI Act条文本身以持股/表决权门槛与标的行业作为适用要件，未见区分收购方是否为外国主体的
排除性条款——本次抓取范围内未找到"仅适用于外资"的官方限定表述，故如实按官方原文的中性
表述处理，不主张这是专门的外资准入配额制度；但在政策语境与实务中，该制度通常被作为英国
"外资安全审查"的对应机制引用（类似其他司法辖区的外资审查/CFIUS式安排）。主管机关是内阁
办公室下设的投资安全部（Investment Security Unit, ISU），与regulation.regulator/
self_regulatory_org记录的FCA/交易所自身监管体系是完全不同的另一条监管线，NSI Act本身
也不特定针对LSE上市公司，覆盖全经济体的合资格实体收购。

capital_controls.zh: 英国自1979年十月23日起全面撤销外汇管制，此后未再恢复：资本可自由跨境流动，外国货币的持有、买卖、境外投资（含全部外币证券投资）不受行政许可限制；这是本项目「英国无资本管制」这一常识性事实少见的、可逐字追溯到官方一手原文（英国议会官方发言记录 Hansard）的样本
capital_controls.en: The UK abolished all remaining exchange controls with effect from midnight on 23 October 1979 and has not reinstated them since: capital moves freely across borders, and there is no administrative licensing restriction on holding, buying, retaining or using foreign currency, or on outward investment including all foreign-currency securities. This is one of the few instances in this project where the commonly-known fact that 'the UK has no capital controls' can be traced verbatim to an official primary record (Hansard, the UK Parliament's official record).
capital_controls.detail:
Chancellor of the Exchequer Sir Geoffrey Howe于1979年6月的预算声明中宣布逐步撤销外汇
管制的意向，同年10月23日在下议院宣布即时撤销全部剩余管制（罗德西亚相关的极小范围例外
除外，该例外本身也早已随历史情势变化而失去现实意义，未见后续恢复管制的记录）。这是
"常识性事实"类字段里少有的、按CLAUDE.md铁律要求真正找到可摘引官方一手原文的案例——
多数"某国无资本管制"这类背景性事实很难在近五十年内找到当次可抓取的原始宣告文本，
英国因1979年撤销管制这一具体历史事件留下了议会官方记录，属于例外情况，不代表其他
交易所同类字段也能类似地找到一手来源。

sources.title: EXCHANGE CONTROLS (Hansard, 23 October 1979)

capital_controls.quote: EXCHANGE CONTROLS (Hansard, 23 October 1979)／HC Deb 23 October 1979 vol 972 cc202-14／I have now decided to remove all the remaining exchange control restrictions from midnight tonight, apart from those still needed, I hope not for long, in relation to Rhodesia. With that single exception, there will from tomorrow be full freedom to buy, retain and use foreign currency for travel, gifts and loans to non-residents, buying property overseas and investment in all foreign currency securities. Portfolio investment will be wholly freed, and the requirement to deposit foreign currency securities with an authorised depositary is abolished.

investor_protection.zh: 金融服务补偿计划（Financial Services Compensation Scheme, FSCS）——依《2000年金融服务与市场法》（FSMA）设立的法定投资者/存款人补偿机制：若受FCA或审慎监管局（PRA）授权的投资公司/顾问倒闭，投资类索赔按2019年4月1日后倒闭案件每人每机构最高赔付£85,000（2010年1月至2019年3月倒闭案件适用£50,000上限，2010年1月前适用£30,000+£20,000累进上限£48,000规则）；FSCS保护范围以该机构从事的具体业务是否属PRA/FCA监管活动为准，并非所有投资产品均受保护
investor_protection.en: The Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) — a statutory investor/depositor compensation scheme established under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (FSMA): where an FCA- or Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)-authorised investment firm or adviser fails, investment claims are compensated up to £85,000 per eligible person per firm for firms that failed after 1 April 2019 (a £50,000 cap applies to failures between January 2010 and March 2019, and 100% of the first £30,000 plus 90% of the next £20,000, capped at £48,000, applies to earlier failures); FSCS protection depends on whether the specific activity the firm was carrying out is a PRA/FCA-regulated activity, and not all investment products are protected
investor_protection.detail:
FSCS是覆盖英国全金融体系（存款/保险/投资/养老金/按揭咨询等）的统一补偿机构，非LSE或
清算体系专属安排，但对英国上市证券的个人投资者而言，是投资中介机构（经纪商/投资顾问）
倒闭时的主要事后救济渠道；与investor_protection常见的另一维度"市场层面的操纵/欺诈执法"
是不同角度，后者见risks.enforcement_note（FCA对UK MAR违规的执法权力），两者互为补充、
不合并。

opening_mechanism.quote: Order book instruments generally follow a trading day consisting of an opening auction, regular trading and, where applicable, a closing auction followed by a closing price crossing session.

closing_mechanism.en: Closing Auction, followed by a brief Closing Price Crossing Session (CPX) allowing continued execution at the closing auction price

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

closing_mechanism.quote: CPX is a short, modified regular trading session that follows the closing auction where executions can only be executed at the closing auction price.

spec.note: Millennium Exchange 中央电子限价订单簿连续撮合（SETS / IOB 等订单驱动品种）+ 两套做市商制度：订单驱动品种用可执行报价 EQ，报价驱动品种（SETSqx / SEAQ / 欧洲报价服务）用非电子可执行的确定报价 Firm Quotes

execution_model.zh: 混合模式：核心为中央电子限价订单簿（Millennium Exchange）连续撮合；同时并行两套注册做市商制度——订单驱动品种（SETS/IOB 等）做市商以可执行报价参与订单簿，报价驱动品种（SETSqx/SEAQ/欧洲报价服务，多为流动性较低的证券）由注册做市商以确定报价提供流动性
execution_model.en: Hybrid: at its core a central electronic limit order book (Millennium Exchange) with continuous matching, running alongside two parallel registered market-maker regimes — market makers in order-driven instruments (SETS, IOB, etc.) quote Executable Quotes into the book, while quote-driven instruments (SETSqx, SEAQ, European Quoting Service — largely less liquid securities) rely on registered market makers providing Firm Quotes
execution_model.detail: enum 依据既有 market_maker_scheme（confidence high）明确记载的订单驱动 + 报价驱动双轨制与 matching_principle（价格优先、显示/非显示优先级）的已核实 quote 综合判定为 hybrid。

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

execution_model.quote: The obligations of market makers in order-driven securities section (rules 4100-4110.6) covers trading services SETS, IOB, securitised derivatives and order book for fixed income securities where registered market makers use Executable Quotes (EQ) to display their quote. The obligations of market makers in quote driven securities section (rules 4200 – 4334.3) covers trading services SETSqx, SEAQ and European Quoting Service where registered market makers use firm quotes to display their quote.

matching_principle.zh: 价格优先原则（Millennium Exchange以价格优先为基础运作）；同价位内展示订单优先于非展示订单（冰山订单非展示部分＞完全隐藏订单＞中间价挂钩订单），除冰山订单非展示部分外，各类别内部再按提交时间优先排序
matching_principle.en: Price priority (Millennium Exchange operates on a price priority basis); at the same price, displayed order portions take precedence over non-displayed portions (iceberg non-display > fully hidden orders > mid-price pegged orders), each category then time-prioritised except for the non-displayed iceberg portion

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

matching_principle.quote: Millennium Exchange operates on a price priority basis. Displayed parts of orders take precedence over non-displayed parts at any price point. With non-display portions of icebergs taking precedence over fully Hidden Orders, which in turn take precedence over Mid-Price Pegged Orders.

spec.note: MIT201 订单类型：限价单、市价单（无价、优先于所有限价单）、止损单 / 止损限价单、冰山单（仅展示部分数量）、隐藏限价单（全隐藏）、中间价挂钩单（仅以买卖中间价成交）

order_types.zh: 限价订单（Limit Order）、市价订单（Market Order，无价格优先于所有限价订单）、止损订单/止损限价订单（Stop/Stop Limit Order）、冰山订单（Iceberg Order，仅展示部分数量）、隐藏限价订单（Hidden Limit Order）、中间价挂钩订单（Mid-Price Pegged Order，仅在盘中以买卖中间价成交）
order_types.en: Limit Order, Market Order (unpriced, has price priority over all priced orders), Stop / Stop Limit Order, Iceberg Order (displays only a portion of total volume), Hidden Limit Order (non-displayed), Mid-Price Pegged Order (executes only at the mid BID/OFFER price during regular trading)

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

order_types.quote: A Market Order is un-priced, and therefore not price forming, but has price priority over all priced orders... An Iceberg Order publicly displays only a portion of its total volume that is available for execution.

tick_size.en: Uses the UK's assimilated EU harmonised tick-size technical standard (retained in UK law after Brexit): the minimum price increment is obtained from a two-dimensional table indexed by the security's price band and by its average daily number of transactions — the higher the price and the lower the liquidity, the coarser the tick; exchange-traded funds use a single (most-liquid) liquidity band
tick_size.detail: 此前留空（数值表在未抓取的 Business Parameters 文档内）。本次以 legislation.gov.uk 托管的 RTS 11（Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/588）官方法条原文（含完整 tick size 表）为准补齐；spec 的 min_tick 留 null——单一最小值随标的价格 / 流动性变动，完整表见 full_table_note 指向的法条（RTS 11 表最小报价单位 0.0001、最大 500，单位同标的计价货币单位）。

type.zh: 非固定百分比涨跌停板，而是逐证券（security-by-security）的价格监控机制——静态价格监控（相对开盘集合竞价价格的偏离阈值）与动态价格监控（相对最近成交价的偏离阈值）触发后，转入波动性拍卖重新形成价格，而非直接停牌
type.en: Not a fixed percentage limit-up/limit-down band; instead a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism — static price monitoring (deviation from the opening auction price) and dynamic price monitoring (deviation from the last traded price) trigger a volatility auction to re-form the price, rather than a straight halt

sources.title: Maintaining orderly markets（官网）

type.quote: Not all circuit breakers work the same way. In the US, market-wide circuit breakers enforce a trading pause for all stocks for 15 minutes. London Stock Exchange's price monitoring functionality is constantly evolving to respond to clients' changing needs and instead, employs a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism.

spec.note: 逐证券价格监控（非固定涨跌停）：富时100 FE10 组静态阈值 8%（相对上次集合竞价价）+ 动态阈值 3%（相对最近成交价），FS10 组 10%/5%；触发转 5 分钟波动性拍卖。band_pct 留 null——分组、且静态/动态两套阈值，无单一值

main_board.zh: 以富时100成分股为例：静态价格监控阈值8%（相对上一次集合竞价成交价），动态价格监控阈值3%（相对最近成交价，触发5分钟波动性拍卖，含最多一次2分钟市价订单延期）；次一流动性梯队（如LSE行业分类FS10）静态阈值10%、动态阈值5%；富时100盘中/收盘/EDSP拍卖的动态阈值比常规交易更紧（FE10为1%，FS10为3%）
main_board.en: For FTSE 100 constituents: static price monitoring threshold 8% (vs. last auction uncrossing price), dynamic threshold 3% (vs. last traded price, triggering a 5-minute volatility auction with up to one 2-minute Market Order extension); the next liquidity tier (e.g. LSE sector FS10) uses 10% static / 5% dynamic; FTSE 100 intraday/closing/EDSP auctions use tighter dynamic thresholds than regular trading (1% for FE10, 3% for FS10)

sources.title: Maintaining orderly markets（官网）

main_board.quote: For the most liquid stocks in the FTSE 100 stocks (e.g. London Stock Exchange sector FE10): – An 8% (Static Price Monitoring %) move from the last auction uncross... would cause a Static Limit volatility auction with 5-minute duration... – Any single order which moves market 3% (Dynamic Price Monitoring %) from last order book traded price would cause a volatility auction of 5-minute duration... For the next most liquid stocks in the FTSE 100 (e.g. London Stock Exchange sector FS10), the Static Price Monitoring % is 10%, and the Dynamic Price Monitoring % is 5%.

other_boards.detail: AIM等其他板块/品种的具体阈值本次未在面向客户的说明性文档中找到，完整数值表在未抓取的Business Parameters文档内，留空不猜。

spec.note: 无美式全市场熔断；逐证券价格监控触发波动性拍卖，见 volatility_interruption

circuit_breaker.zh: 个股级价格监控机制（无美股式全市场熔断）：不同于美国基于标普500指数跌幅触发的全市场熔断（暂停全部股票交易15分钟），伦敦证券交易所采用逐证券的价格监控功能
circuit_breaker.en: Stock-level price monitoring mechanism (no US-style market-wide circuit breaker): unlike US market-wide circuit breakers that pause all stocks for 15 minutes based on S&P 500 declines, LSE employs a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism
circuit_breaker.detail: 同一份说明文档明确将美式全市场熔断作为对照系统提及，是本项目目前少数能在同一原文里直接对比两种机制设计哲学差异的样本。

circuit_breaker.quote: In the US, market-wide circuit breakers enforce a trading pause for all stocks for 15 minutes. London Stock Exchange's price monitoring functionality is constantly evolving to respond to clients' changing needs and instead, employs a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism.

spec.note: 静态价格监控（相对上次集合竞价价）+ 动态价格监控（相对最近成交价）触发 5 分钟波动性拍卖（含最多一次 2 分钟市价订单延期）；富时100 FE10 组静态 8%/动态 3%，FS10 组 10%/5%（见 price_limits），故两个 pct 键均留 null；每次拍卖及延期后另加最长 30 秒随机

volatility_interruption.zh: 静态价格监控（Static Price Monitoring）与动态价格监控（Dynamic Price Monitoring）触发后转入波动性拍卖（volatility auction），价格重新形成后恢复常规交易；每次拍卖及延期后另设最长30秒随机时间
volatility_interruption.en: Static and Dynamic Price Monitoring trigger a volatility auction; once the price re-forms, regular trading resumes; each auction/extension is followed by a random period of up to 30 seconds

sources.title: Maintaining orderly markets（官网）

volatility_interruption.quote: Circuit breakers are tools that temporarily halt trading activity or delay an auction execution if certain price movement tolerances would be breached. Following the halt, the affected security will be placed into auction allowing a price to be formed in an orderly fashion... Note that each auction and extension is followed by a random period of up to 30 seconds.

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 两套并行机制：(1) FCA可依UKLR暂停/取消证券上市（如未达持续义务、市场平稳运行受威胁等，暂停满6个月须与FCA讨论是否取消上市）；(2) 交易所自身的技术性市场干预（Service Interruptions Protocol）——因系统故障等严重事件，可对受影响证券实施Halt（禁止新订单但可撤单）、Suspension（订单簿冻结，禁止新增和撤销）或Halt and Close（当日不再恢复交易，直接设定收盘价）三种状态之一
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Two parallel mechanisms: (1) the FCA may suspend/cancel a listing under UKLR (e.g. failure to meet continuing obligations, threat to orderly market operation; after 6 months of suspension the issuer must discuss cancellation with the FCA); (2) the Exchange's own technical market interventions under its Service Interruptions Protocol — for major system outages, affected securities may be placed into Halt (no new orders, deletions allowed), Market/Partition Suspension (order book frozen, no new orders or deletions) or Halt and Close (trading will not resume that day; a closing price is set)

sources.title: UKLR UK Listing Rules sourcebook（FCA Handbook）
MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网，第11章）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: 11.4.1 Halt / If London Stock Exchange specifically wishes to prevent further order entry, then it will place the market in a Halt state, which does not allow the entry of new orders... 11.4.2 Market/Partition Suspension... 11.4.3 Halt and Close / This state will be used if London Stock Exchange concludes that there is no prospect of trading resuming on the trading day of the outage.

spec.note: 交易所视一切成交为 firm，仅在例外情形作 Exchange enforced cancellation（Rule 2120–2121），可应会员申请或交易所自行发起。无固定价格偏离百分比门槛，代之以：成交须『manifestly erroneous』、双方无法用 contra facility 自行冲销、且申请方潜在损失达最低标准——股票单只 £100,000 / 多只 £200,000，ETF/ETP £50,000 / £100,000。申请须在成交后 30 分钟内提交 Market Supervision（收盘 16:30 后的收盘拍卖成交须在 17:00 前）。交易所决定为终局，无上诉；只作废、不调价

error_trade_rule.zh: 交易所将其规则下的所有成交视为确定（firm），仅在例外情形下由交易所强制作废（Exchange enforced cancellation，规则 2120–2121）——可应会员申请或交易所自行发起（如公司事件明显误传、收盘拍卖被错单严重扭曲）。会员申请须在成交后 30 分钟内提交市场监察部门；待作废成交须经交易所判断为『明显错误（manifestly erroneous）』，且双方无法通过 contra 冲销机制自行处理，申请方潜在损失须达门槛（股票单只 £100,000、多只 £200,000；ETF/ETP 单只 £50,000、多只 £100,000）。交易所决定为终局，只作废不调价
error_trade_rule.en: The Exchange treats all trades under its rules as firm; only in exceptional circumstances will it undertake an Exchange enforced cancellation (Rules 2120–2121), on a member firm's request or of its own volition (e.g. a clear miscommunication of a corporate event, or a closing price significantly distorted by erroneous orders in the closing auction). A member firm's request must reach the Market Supervision department within 30 minutes of the trade time; the trade must be manifestly erroneous in the Exchange's judgement, the parties must be unable to use the contra facility, and the requesting firm's potential loss must reach a threshold (£100,000 for a single stock, £200,000 across more than one). The Exchange's decision is final; trades are cancelled, not price-adjusted
error_trade_rule.detail: Rule 2120–2121（Exchange enforced cancellation of erroneous trades）+ Guidance to Rule。与 trading_halt_mechanism（系统故障停牌）不同。无固定 % 偏离阈值——LSE 用『manifestly erroneous + 损失门槛 + 市场影响』的裁量标准，故 spec.deviation_threshold_pct 留 null。

sources.title: RULES OF THE LONDON STOCK EXCHANGE（Rulebook，effective 19 January 2026，Rule 2120–2121）

error_trade_rule.quote: The Exchange views all trades undertaken under its rules as firm. However, the Exchange may, in exceptional circumstances, undertake an Exchange enforced cancellation of an automated trade executed on the trading system, either at the request of a member firm or of its own volition. ... any requests from member firms to cancel trades should be made to the Market Supervision department as soon as possible and in any event within 30 minutes of the trade time. ... any trades to be cancelled must be manifestly erroneous in the judgement of the Exchange. ... the Market Supervision department will only consider an Exchange enforced cancellation where the amount of loss is £100,000 or more in relation to automated trades conducted in a single stock on the trading system and £200,000 or more in relation to automated trades conducted in more than one stock

short_selling.zh: 《2025年卖空规则》（Short Selling Regulations 2025, SSR 2025）——脱欧后英国自订的独立卖空监管框架，2026年7月13日起正式取代此前“承接”的欧盟《卖空条例》（Regulation (EU) No 236/2012）。持有可报告股票净空头仓位达0.2%阈值须向FCA报告，FCA公布匿名化的汇总净空头仓位（ANSP）；FCA保留在特殊情形下实施限制/禁止卖空的紧急权力
short_selling.en: Short Selling Regulations 2025 (SSR 2025) — the UK's own post-Brexit short-selling framework, which from 13 July 2026 replaced the previously-assimilated EU Short Selling Regulation (Regulation (EU) No 236/2012). Net short positions in reportable shares must be notified to the FCA once the 0.2% threshold is reached; the FCA publishes anonymised Aggregate Net Short Positions (ANSP); the FCA retains emergency powers to restrict or ban short selling in exceptional circumstances

short_selling.quote: The SSR is set out in the Short Selling Regulations 2025 (SSR 2025) and the Short Selling Rules Sourcebook within the FCA Handbook. These form the legal and regulatory framework for short selling in the UK. The new SSR applies from 13 July 2026. It replaces the assimilated EU Short Selling Regulation (Regulation (EU) No 236/2012)... The FCA publishes daily current and historic ANSP reports. These show the aggregated net short positions in companies based on reported net short positions above the 0.2% threshold.

order_book_transparency.zh: 盘前：SETS 为公开的中央限价订单簿，展示订单的价量向市场披露（Millennium Exchange 以价格优先运作，展示部分优先于非展示部分）；同一订单簿内支持不披露的流动性——冰山订单仅展示部分数量、隐藏限价订单全隐藏、中间价挂钩订单仅以买卖中间价成交，均排在同价展示订单之后。盘后：适用英国承接的 MiFIR 成交透明度制度，大额成交（LIS）可延迟披露
order_book_transparency.en: Pre-trade: SETS is a public central limit order book whose displayed order sizes and prices are disseminated to the market (Millennium Exchange operates on price priority, with displayed portions ahead of non-displayed); the same book supports undisclosed liquidity — Iceberg Orders show only a portion, Hidden Limit Orders are fully non-displayed, and Mid-Price Pegged Orders execute only at the mid, all ranked behind displayed orders at the same price. Post-trade: under the UK's assimilated MiFIR transparency regime, large-in-scale (LIS) trades may be published on a deferred basis
order_book_transparency.detail: 字段管本所订单簿内部的（非）展示流动性；独立暗池 / MTF 实体（Turquoise）见 dark_pool，行情层级 / 收费见第十章 market_data_levels。quote 复用 MIT201 已核实的展示 / 非展示优先级表述；盘后 LIS 延迟披露为 UK MiFIR 一般制度，未逐字核实交易所侧参数，故整体 confidence: medium。

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

order_book_transparency.quote: Millennium Exchange operates on a price priority basis. Displayed parts of orders take precedence over non-displayed parts at any price point. With non-display portions of icebergs taking precedence over fully Hidden Orders, which in turn take precedence over Mid-Price Pegged Orders.

dark_pool.zh: 本所自身订单簿（SETS）内含非展示/隐藏订单类型（冰山订单非展示部分、隐藏限价订单、中间价挂钩订单），可在同一订单簿内实现部分非展示流动性；集团内另设独立法人实体Turquoise（LSEG于2009年12月取得多数股权的泛欧交易平台）专营暗池/多边交易设施业务，但那是与本交易所不同的法人实体，不计入本字段
dark_pool.en: The Exchange's own order book (SETS) supports non-displayed/hidden order types (iceberg non-display portions, Hidden Limit Orders, Mid-Price Pegged Orders), enabling some non-displayed liquidity within the same book; a separate LSEG group entity, Turquoise (majority stake acquired December 2009), operates as a dedicated pan-European dark/MTF venue, but it is a distinct legal entity from this Exchange and is not counted under this field

market_maker_scheme.zh: 分订单驱动与报价驱动两套做市商制度：SETS/IOB/证券化衍生品/固定收益订单簿等订单驱动品种，注册做市商以可执行报价（Executable Quotes）参与；SETSqx/SEAQ/欧洲报价服务等报价驱动品种，注册做市商以非电子可执行的确定报价（Firm Quotes）参与，且仅具备中央对手方清算资格的会员机构方可注册为报价驱动品种做市商
market_maker_scheme.en: Two parallel market maker regimes: order-driven instruments (SETS, IOB, securitised derivatives, fixed income order book) use registered market makers quoting Executable Quotes; quote-driven instruments (SETSqx, SEAQ, European Quoting Service) use registered market makers providing non-electronically-executable Firm Quotes, and only member firms with central counterparty clearing capability may register as quote-driven market makers

sources.title: MIT201 – Guide to the Trading System Issue 15.8（官网）

market_maker_scheme.quote: The obligations of market makers in order-driven securities section (rules 4100-4110.6) covers trading services SETS, IOB, securitised derivatives and order book for fixed income securities where registered market makers use Executable Quotes (EQ) to display their quote. The obligations of market makers in quote driven securities section (rules 4200 – 4334.3) covers trading services SETSqx, SEAQ and European Quoting Service where registered market makers use firm quotes to display their quote. Only member firms that have at least one Member ID that supports central counterparty clearing arrangements are permitted to register to provide firm quotes.

connect_schemes.zh: 深港通式安排：深圳-伦敦互联互通（Shenzhen-London Stock Connect），使境外投资者可通过在伦敦挂牌的存托凭证项目间接投资中国A股，亦使符合条件的英国上市发行人通过存托凭证项目在深圳交易所挂牌、触达中国投资者
connect_schemes.en: Shenzhen-London Stock Connect: enables international investors to access Chinese A-Shares via a depositary receipt programme listed in London, and enables qualifying UK-listed issuers to be admitted to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange via depositary receipt programmes to access Chinese investors

sources.title: Admission and Disclosure Standards（官网，术语表）

connect_schemes.quote: Shenzhen-London Stock Connect is a collaboration between the Exchange and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, which enables (i) investors to access Chinese A-Shares through a depositary receipt programme listed in London; and (ii) qualifying listed issuers, through separate depository receipt programmes, to be admitted to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and access Chinese investors in Shenzhen.

boards.financial_threshold: 股票类证券预期总市值须达至少£3,000万（£30m）；须有至少10%股份于admission后处于公众持有（shares in public hands）；债券类最低£20万，封闭式/开放式投资基金最低£70万
boards.target_companies: 受监管市场（UK Regulated Market），纳入FCA官方名册（Official List），适用UKLR全套上市与持续监管义务；含官方名册内的Specialist Fund Segment与High Growth Segment两个不纳入官方名册的子板块（见下）

boards.financial_threshold: AIM规则未设最低市值或最低公众持股比例的强制门槛，核心准入条件是必须始终委任一名获认可的保荐人（Nominated Adviser／Nomad）
boards.target_companies: 面向中小型成长企业；AIM证券不纳入FCA官方名册（Official List），属交易所自身运营的多边交易设施（MTF）而非受监管市场，监管相对UKLR更为灵活
面向专业投资者的债券/存托凭证专门市场，是交易所运营的MTF而非受监管市场，证券不纳入官方名册
面向专业投资者的债券/存托凭证市场，是交易所运营的英国MTF，但须依《上市规则》第4章完成上市
面向暂不满足官方名册资格条件（尤其公众持股比例偏低）、但意图未来申请纳入官方名册的高增长交易型企业；是受监管市场（Main Market）的一部分，但证券不纳入官方名册
面向机构、专业及知情投资者的封闭式投资实体；是受监管市场（Main Market）的一部分，但证券不纳入官方名册

review_system.zh: 披露为本，2024年7月UKLR改革后以单一“股票证券（商业公司）”类别取代此前Premium/Standard两级架构；申请人须在多类触发事件（如须发布招股说明书、反向收购通函等）委任一名保荐人（Sponsor）向FCA确认其符合UKLR相关要求
review_system.en: Disclosure-based; following the July 2024 UKLR reform, a single 'equity shares (commercial companies)' category replaced the previous two-tier Premium/Standard structure. Issuers must appoint a Sponsor on multiple trigger events (e.g. when a prospectus or reverse-takeover circular is required) to confirm compliance with the relevant UKLR requirements to the FCA
review_system.detail:
披露为本+保荐人（Sponsor）在特定触发事件下向监管者背书的把关模式，属 ADR-023
重新划分后的 `disclosure_with_discretion` 类（裁量权由保荐人代为行使，而非交易所
自身委员会，但同属"披露基础上仍有实质把关"这一大类）。

An issuer with a listing of equity shares in... the equity shares (commercial companies) category... must appoint a sponsor on each occasion that the issuer: (1) is required to submit... a prospectus or supplementary prospectus... UKLR TP 2 applies from 29 July 2024.

listing_process_duration.zh: 本字段仅指规则本身设定的最短提前通知期，非企业筹备上市全过程的市场惯例周期（后者本次未找到官方原文，未纳入）。AIM：申请人须在预期挂牌日至少10个工作日前提交Schedule One信息（「合资格投资者」申请人为至少20个工作日前），至少3个工作日前提交完整申请表与电子版挂牌文件；主板（Official List）：FCA要求申请人最迟于FCA审议该申请之日的中午前2个工作日，提交申请人基本信息、证券信息、董事联系方式确认等材料
listing_process_duration.en: This field captures only the minimum advance-notice periods fixed by the rules themselves, not the market-practice duration of a company's full IPO preparation (no citable primary source for the latter was found this session). AIM: an applicant must provide Schedule One information at least 10 business days before the expected admission date (20 business days for a 'quoted applicant'), and submit the completed application form and electronic admission document at least 3 business days before the expected admission date. Main Market (Official List): the FCA requires applicants to submit specified applicant/security information and director contact confirmations by midday 2 business days before the FCA is to consider the application
listing_process_duration.detail:
两套规则的性质不同：AIM的10/20个工作日窗口是给交易所/提名顾问（Nomad）预留的信息审查期，
主板的"2个工作日"则是FCA就单次审议会议要求的最终材料截止时点，二者不是同一维度的
"流程周期"，不能直接横向相加或比较。真实的企业上市全流程（从决定上市到挂牌交易）
通常以数月计（涉及尽职调查、招股说明书/AIM挂牌文件编制、路演等），但这部分周期没有
监管规则强制规定的固定天数，本次未找到LSE/FCA官方原文对此给出具体周数或月数的正式
声明，故不采纳网络流传的"5周"之类说法，只记录规则条文本身明确写出的最短提前期。
AIM Rules原文将"十/二十/三个工作日"拼写为英文单词（ten/twenty/three）而非阿拉伯数字，
zh/en字段里的"10/20/3"是转写自单词的阿拉伯数字（内容真实、逐字对应，只是数字书写
形式不同），为避免`validate.py`反查规则误判成"数字对不上"，confidence如实降一档标
medium，而非勉强找无关文字凑数字。

continuing_obligations.zh: 官方名册内公司适用UKLR第6章持续义务（equity shares (commercial companies) 类别）；AIM公司须始终保留一名保荐人（Nominated Adviser），由其负责持续评估公司对AIM监管框架的适当性
continuing_obligations.en: Official List companies are subject to UKLR Chapter 6 continuing obligations (equity shares (commercial companies) category); AIM companies must retain a Nominated Adviser at all times, responsible for the ongoing assessment of the company's appropriateness for AIM's regulatory framework

sources.title: AIM Rules for Companies（官网）

continuing_obligations.quote: In order to be eligible for AIM, an applicant must appoint a nominated adviser and an AIM company must retain a nominated adviser at all times. The nominated adviser is responsible to the Exchange for assessing the appropriateness of each applicant for AIM.

suspension_resumption.zh: FCA可依UKLR 21.1在市场平稳运行受威胁或需保护投资者时暂停上市；暂停满6个月后发行人须与FCA讨论是否取消上市或延长暂停
suspension_resumption.en: The FCA may suspend a listing under UKLR 21.1 where the smooth operation of the market is jeopardised or investor protection requires it; after 6 months of suspension the issuer must discuss with the FCA whether to cancel the listing or extend the suspension

sources.title: UKLR UK Listing Rules sourcebook（FCA Handbook）

suspension_resumption.quote: UKLR 21.1.1 (1) The FCA may suspend, with effect from such time as it may determine, the listing of any securities if the smooth operation of the market is, or may be, temporarily jeopardised or it is necessary to protect investors... UKLR 21.1.5 Where the listing of an issuer's securities has been suspended for 6 months, the issuer must contact the FCA as soon as possible after the end of that period to discuss whether a cancellation of listing is appropriate.

delisting_conditions.zh: FCA认定存在阻碍证券正常常规交易的特殊情形即可取消上市，典型触发情形包括：证券已不再符合本规则要求获准交易；发行人不再满足持续义务（如公众持股比例跌破10%，FCA可给予合理期限恢复但受市场平稳运行/投资者保护需要限制）；暂停上市已满6个月；发行人完成反向收购或“初始交易”（initial transaction）
delisting_conditions.en: The FCA may cancel a listing where it is satisfied that special circumstances preclude normal regular dealings, including: securities no longer admitted to trading as required; the issuer no longer satisfying continuing obligations (e.g. shares in public hands falling below 10%, subject to a reasonable restoration period unless precluded by market-order/investor-protection needs); the listing having been suspended for more than 6 months; or the issuer completing a reverse takeover or 'initial transaction'

sources.title: UKLR UK Listing Rules sourcebook（FCA Handbook）

delisting_conditions.quote: The FCA may cancel the listing of securities if it is satisfied that there are special circumstances that preclude normal regular dealings in them... the issuer no longer satisfies its continuing obligations for listing – for example, if the percentage of shares in public hands falls below 10%... the securities' listing has been suspended for more than 6 months... the issuer has completed a reverse takeover or initial transaction.

delisting_process.detail: 发行人主动申请取消上市（Cancellation at issuer's request）须满足UKLR 21.2.8-21.2.18及21.3的具体程序要求，本次未逐条核实完整流程细节。

delisting_transition_period.zh: 主板（Official List）：发行人主动申请取消上市须发出致股东通函（须先经FCA审批），通函须载明取消上市的预计生效日期，该日期不得早于股东大会通过取消决议之日起20个工作日；决议须获不少于75%已投票表决权支持（如有控股股东，还须获独立股东表决权75%以上支持）。AIM：须至少提前20个工作日通知交易所拟取消挂牌的日期，取消一般须经不少于75%已投票表决权同意；取消须在股东批准后至少5个工作日方可生效
delisting_transition_period.en: Main Market (Official List): an issuer requesting voluntary cancellation must send shareholders a circular (which must first be approved by the FCA) stating the anticipated cancellation date, which must be not less than 20 business days after the resolution to cancel is passed at a general meeting; the resolution requires approval by not less than 75% of the votes cast (and, where there is a controlling shareholder, also a majority of independent shareholders' votes). AIM: the company must notify the Exchange of its preferred cancellation date at least 20 business days in advance, cancellation generally requires the consent of not less than 75% of votes cast, and cancellation does not take effect until at least 5 business days after shareholder approval is obtained
delisting_transition_period.detail:
两套板块的"整理期"机制高度相似（20个工作日通知期+75%表决权门槛），这不是巧合——AIM
规则历史上参照了彼时Listing Rules的退市程序设计，2024年7月UKLR改革后主板一侧的具体
条文编号变为UKLR 21.2.8R，但20工作日+75%的核心参数未变。两者的差异在于AIM额外明确
"取消决议通过后再等5个工作日方可生效"这一层，主板本次抓取的条文未见对应的"决议通过
后二次等待期"表述（决议本身即需在20工作日窗口内进行）。要约收购触发的强制退市另有
独立于本字段的简化规则（如收购方通过要约/强制收购程序达到75%接纳时可援引不同的通知
路径），未展开。

delisting_transition_period.quote: (1) send a circular to the holders of the relevant shares. The circular must: ... (c) include the anticipated date of cancellation (which must be not less than 20 business days following the passing of the resolution referred to in paragraph (2)); (2) obtain, at a general meeting, the prior approval of a resolution for the cancellation from: (a) a majority of not less than 75% of the votes attaching to the shares voted on the resolution.／An AIM company which wishes the Exchange to cancel admission of its AIM securities must notify such intended cancellation and must separately inform the Exchange of its preferred cancellation date at least twenty business days prior to such date and save where the Exchange otherwise agrees, the cancellation shall be conditional upon the consent of not less than 75% of votes cast by its shareholders given in a general meeting.／Cancellation will not take effect until at least five business days have passed since shareholder approval has been obtained and a dealing notice has been issued.

post_delisting_venue.zh: LSE/AIM规则本身不指定任何强制性的「继受交易场所」：AIM Rule 41明确要求发行人在致股东的取消上市通知中自行说明「股东在证券被取消挂牌后将如何进行交易」，具体安排（是否、以及通过何种场外撮合平台继续交易）由发行人自主决定并向股东披露，非交易所强制指定。实务中部分已退市公司股份会转由JP Jenkins、Asset Match等独立的「配对成交」（matched bargain）撮合平台提供有限的场外流动性，但这些平台与LSE/AIM之间不存在制度性的强制继受关系
post_delisting_venue.en: LSE/AIM rules do not mandate any successor trading venue: AIM Rule 41 requires the departing company itself to set out, in the shareholder cancellation notice, a description of how shareholders will be able to effect transactions in the AIM securities once they have been cancelled — the arrangement (if any) is decided and disclosed by the company itself, not designated by the Exchange. In practice, some delisted companies' shares move to independent matched-bargain facilities such as JP Jenkins or Asset Match for limited off-exchange liquidity, but there is no institutional or mandatory successor relationship between such platforms and LSE/AIM
post_delisting_venue.detail:
本次抓取范围内未见主板（Official List）取消上市的对应条文要求发行人作类似的"退市后交易
安排说明"披露（UKLR 21.2.8R对通函内容的要求集中在取消决议/日期本身，未提及交易安排
说明义务），故本字段的"发行人自行说明安排"这一核心事实目前只在AIM层面找到明确原文
支撑，主板是否有类似惯例/软性预期未展开核实。JP Jenkins/Asset Match为公开可查的
配对成交平台名称，仅作为"实务中常见去向"的说明性举例，未单独核实其官方定位为"AIM
退市股份指定继受平台"（并非交易所指定，只是市场自发形成的惯常选择），故不计入quote，
confidence判断仅以AIM Rule 41原文为准。

default_management.zh: LCH Ltd（本所CCP，见ccp_name）对EquityClear（证券清算业务线）设有分层「违约处置瀑布」（Default Waterfall）：违约会员自身的初始保证金/追加保证金等各类保证金及其违约基金出资首先被吸收→LCH LTD自有资本出资（「风险共担」，截至2024年10月末为€1.6百万，四条业务线中最低，与EquityClear业务线整体风险规模匹配）→非违约会员对EquityClear违约基金的出资（截至2024年10月末规模£155百万，可通过「追加缴款」Assessment进一步补充）→服务连续性阶段的损失分摊（Loss Distribution）→自愿服务连续性→EquityClear服务关闭（最终手段）。LCH LTD截至2024年10月31日持有的保证金抵押品市值合计€288十亿
default_management.en: LCH Ltd (this Exchange's CCP, see ccp_name) operates a tiered Default Waterfall for its EquityClear (securities clearing) service line: the defaulting member's own margin (initial, variation, delivery and additional margins) and its default fund contribution are absorbed first, then LCH LTD's own capital ('skin in the game', €1.6mn as of end-October 2024 — the smallest of the four service lines, scaled to EquityClear's relative risk size), then non-defaulting members' EquityClear default fund contributions (£155mn as of end-October 2024, further replenishable via callable 'Assessments'), then loss distribution during the service continuity phase, then voluntary service continuity, and finally EquityClear service closure as a last resort. LCH LTD held margin collateral with a total market value of €288bn as of 31 October 2024
default_management.detail:
LCH LTD同时为ForexClear（外汇）、Rates Derivatives（利率衍生品）、EquityClear（证券）、
RepoClear（回购）四条业务线分别设立独立的违约基金与自有资本出资额度，不同业务线之间
风险不交叉污染——EquityClear的€1.6mn LCH自有资本出资与£155mn违约基金规模，相较
Rates Derivatives（€61.9mn资本/£6,014mn基金）小得多，反映证券现货清算相对利率衍生品
清算的风险敞口更低。术语译法见schema/glossary.yml新增`default-waterfall`条目。本字段
的信息来源是一份"瀑布流程图"型PDF而非叙述性条文，摘引的quote由图中各阶段标签与脚注
文字按图示顺序拼接而成，非重新组织的转述。

investor_structure.zh: 按国家统计局（ONS）2026年1月发布的两年一期官方口径，2024年末英国本土注册、在LSE挂牌的公司普通股总值£2.54万亿，其中境外投资者持有比例连续多年上升，2024年末达58.8%的历史新高（2022年为57.7%），美国投资者以£6,939亿居境外持有人之首；英国境内个人投资者持股11.6%（£2,950亿，历史新高）；银行持股3.6%（历史新高）；公共部门（含2008年金融危机后遗留的银行持股）持股0.2%（£47亿，较2022年£135亿继续下降）
investor_structure.en: Per the Office for National Statistics' (ONS) biennial official bulletin published January 2026, the total value of ordinary shares in UK-domiciled companies listed on the LSE was £2.54 trillion at end-2024; the proportion held by overseas beneficiaries has risen for years, reaching a record high of 58.8% at end-2024 (up from 57.7% in 2022), with US-based holders leading foreign ownership at £693.9bn. UK-resident individuals held 11.6% (£295.0bn, a record high); banks held a record 3.6%; the public sector (a legacy of post-2008 financial-crisis bank stakes) held 0.2% (£4.7bn, down from £13.5bn in 2022)
investor_structure.detail:
该统计口径为"由LSE认定注册国为英国的挂牌公司"的普通股，与overview章节因LSEG集团口径

account_opening_requirements.zh: 适用英国通用的反洗钱客户尽职调查（Customer Due Diligence, CDD）规则，而非LSE专属开户规则：依《2017年洗钱、恐怖主义融资与资金转移（付款人信息）条例》（Money Laundering Regulations 2017）第28条，受监管机构（含证券经纪商）须在建立业务关系前识别并核实客户身份、了解业务关系或临时交易的目的与性质；客户为法人实体时须另行获取并核实名称、注册号、注册地址等信息，并在客户存在受益所有人时识别、核实受益所有人身份
account_opening_requirements.en: This is the UK's general anti-money-laundering customer due diligence (CDD) regime, not an LSE-specific account-opening rule: under Regulation 28 of the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017, a relevant person (including securities brokers) must identify and verify a customer's identity before establishing a business relationship, and assess the purpose and intended nature of that relationship or occasional transaction; where the customer is a body corporate, the firm must also obtain and verify its name, registration number and registered address, and identify and verify any beneficial owner
account_opening_requirements.detail:
本字段描述的是英国全金融体系统一适用的CDD/KYC法定底线，任何经纪商为客户开立可交易
LSE证券的账户均须遵守，并非LSE自身另订的准入门槛（LSE本身的准入规则是对"会员机构"
而非"终端投资者"的资格要求，见membership_structure字段）。具体到零售经纪商的开户
实操（身份证件种类、地址证明有效期等）由各经纪商自行落实监管要求的细节，未在受监管
法条原文中逐条列明，故本字段只记录法定义务本身而非经纪商操作细则。

sources.title: The Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017, Regulation 28（legislation.gov.uk官方立法数据库）

account_opening_requirements.quote: The Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017／28. —(1) This regulation applies when a relevant person is required by regulation 27 to apply customer due diligence measures. (2) The relevant person must— (a) identify the customer unless the identity of that customer is known to, and has been verified by, the relevant person; (b) verify the customer's identity unless the customer's identity has already been verified by the relevant person; and (c) assess, and where appropriate obtain information on, the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship or occasional transaction. Where the customer is a body corporate— (a) the relevant person must obtain and verify— (i) the name of the body corporate; (ii) its company number or other registration number; (iii) the address of its registered office, and if different, its principal place of business

suitability_management.zh: 适用英国通用的FCA行为准则手册COBS（Conduct of Business Sourcebook）适当性规则：经纪商/投资顾问提供投资建议或组合管理服务时，须取得客户在相关金融工具知识与经验、财务状况（含承受损失能力）、投资目标（含风险容忍度）三方面的必要信息，并据此确保推荐的投资服务/金融工具与决策符合客户的风险承受能力与承受损失能力
suitability_management.en: This is the UK's general FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook (COBS) suitability regime: a firm providing investment advice or portfolio management must obtain the necessary information about a client's (a) knowledge and experience relevant to the specific type of financial instrument, (b) financial situation including ability to bear losses, and (c) investment objectives including risk tolerance, and must ensure recommended investment services, financial instruments and trading decisions are suitable for that client's risk tolerance and ability to bear losses
suitability_management.detail:
COBS 9A（脱胎于欧盟MiFID II第25(2)条、经英国脱欧后内嵌为FCA Handbook独立规则手册）
适用于MiFID业务范畴，是英国全市场统一的适当性框架，非LSE专属；对非咨询类服务另有
COBS 10"适当性"（Appropriateness）规则（要求更低，仅需评估知识经验而非全套三要素），
两者是不同强度的两层规则，本字段以覆盖面更广、要求更高的COBS 9A"适当性"（Suitability）
为主。

sources.title: FCA Handbook - COBS 9A Suitability (MiFID and insurance-based investment products provisions)

suitability_management.quote: When providing investment advice or portfolio management a firm must: (1) obtain the necessary information regarding the client's: (a) knowledge and experience in the investment field relevant to the specific type of financial instrument, insurance-based investment product or service; (b) financial situation including his ability to bear losses; and (c) investment objectives including his risk tolerance, so as to comply with (2); (2) only recommend investment services, financial instruments and insurance-based investment products, as applicable, or take decisions to trade, which are suitable for the client and, in particular, in accordance with the client's risk tolerance and ability to bear losses.

foreign_access_channel.zh: 两条并行通道：(1) 直接会员通道——境外证券商可在英国或「适格境外法域」获授权监管（或经交易所认定资本充足性/诚信与专业能力已受充分监管）后直接成为LSE会员机构，无须以英国本土法人身份接入（见membership_structure）；(2) 存托凭证/互联互通通道——境外投资者亦可通过在LSE挂牌的国际存托凭证（IOB交易服务）或专项互联互通安排（如深圳-伦敦互联互通）间接接触境内证券，无需直接开立LSE交易权限
foreign_access_channel.en: Two parallel channels: (1) direct membership — an overseas broker authorised under UK or an 'appropriate overseas' jurisdiction (or otherwise deemed sufficiently regulated by the Exchange in respect of capital adequacy and fitness/probity) may become an LSE member firm directly, without needing to be a UK-incorporated legal entity (see membership_structure); (2) depositary receipts / connect schemes — overseas investors can also gain indirect access via international depositary receipts listed on LSE (International Order Book) or dedicated connect arrangements (e.g. Shenzhen-London Stock Connect), without opening direct LSE trading access

membership_structure.quote: A member firm must at all times be authorised under relevant United Kingdom, or appropriate overseas legislation, or in the view of the Exchange be otherwise sufficiently regulated, in respect of capital adequacy, and fitness and probity... A member firm must hold a valid, issued and duly renewed LEI code at all times... A member firm must, to ensure compliance with these rules, at all times have: adequate trade execution, recording, reporting and settlement procedures and systems... sufficient staff with adequate knowledge, experience, training and competence; adequate internal procedures and controls; and one or more compliance officers.

broker_landscape.zh: 《伦敦证券交易所规则》将会员机构在订单簿上的交易行为区分为「代理经纪商」（Agency Broker，为客户下单执行、须对客户履约负责）与充当「零售服务商」（Retail Service Provider, RSP）的做市/自营性质会员——RSP是就零售规模订单持续按当前订单簿最优价提供成交承诺的会员机构，零售经纪商通常并非LSE直接会员，而是依托RSP网络的报价承诺为终端零售客户执行订单，规则本身对「利用RSP既有报价承诺、在其之前抢先在订单簿制造新最优价」这类行为专门作出了不当交易行为的界定
broker_landscape.en: The Rules of the London Stock Exchange distinguish between member firms acting as an 'Agency Broker' (executing orders on behalf of clients and responsible for performance to those clients) and members acting as a Retail Service Provider (RSP) — a dealer/market-making-type member firm that stands ready to deal at the current best order-book price for retail-sized orders. Retail brokers are typically not direct LSE members themselves; they route client orders to be executed against RSPs' standing quote commitments, and the Rules specifically define as improper conduct the practice of exploiting an RSP's prior quote commitment by creating a new best price ahead of it on the order book
broker_landscape.detail:
本次抓取范围内未找到"RSP"这一缩写在《伦敦证券交易所规则》定义章节（Definitions）
的正式释义条目，摘引的原文来自Core Rules章节里对不当交易行为的说明性文字，是从
RSP在实务中如何运作反推出的描述，而非规则本身给出的正式定义句——故confidence标
medium而非high。RSP机制是英国零售股票经纪市场的标志性结构（多数零售经纪商本身
不是LSE会员，而是依托一批做市商/自营交易商的RSP报价网络执行客户订单），与订单簿
直接撮合的机构投资者交易路径是两种不同的市场微观结构，日后如需更完整定义宜专门
抓取LSE面向零售中介的说明文档（本次未纳入抓取范围）。

sources.title: Rules of the London Stock Exchange（官网）

broker_landscape.quote: Certain trading practices that exploit the commitment given by firms that act as RSPs are considered to be detrimental to the fairness and integrity of the Exchange's markets and should be discouraged. For example, an order is entered onto the order book with the intention of creating a new best price, away from generally accepted trading levels, for the principle purpose of executing a larger order against an RSP by virtue of the RSP's previous commitment to deal on the basis of the current best order book price.

market_data_levels.zh: 分三档：Level 2（订单簿全深度，含全部报价/订单及Level 1全部内容，如开盘价/收盘价/揭示价及数量、最优价及数量）、Level 1（最优价及数量、每证券成交额、揭示成交量指示、开盘价、最高最低成交价、逐笔成交、收盘价、全部成交VWAP、累计成交量、揭示价及数量、盘后成交数据）、Post-trade Data（场内/场外成交报告及TRADEcho场外系统性内部撮合商报价）
market_data_levels.en: Three tiers: Level 2 (full order-book depth, including all quotes and orders plus everything in Level 1, e.g. open/close/uncrossing prices and volumes, best price and volume), Level 1 (best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high/low, individual trades, closing prices, all-trades VWAP, cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume, Post-trade Data), and Post-trade Data (on-book/on-exchange trade reports and TRADEcho systematic internaliser quoting)

sources.title: Schedule A – Price List and Data Products（官网，01 January 2026）

market_data_levels.quote: Level 2 includes full depth of the book with all quotes, orders and Level 1 Data including trades, open price, close price, uncrossing price plus volume, best price plus volume. Level 1 includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP, cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume, Post-trade Data. Post-trade Data includes on-book, on-exchange trade reports and TRADEcho SI quoting for the respective market.

data_latency.zh: 行情数据按时效性分三类许可：Real Time Data（实时数据，经再分发许可对专业客户/私人投资者提供）、Delayed Data（延时数据，经「延时及收市后数据再分发许可」以受控机制分发）、After Midnight Data（收市后数据，经「历史数据再分发许可」以不受控机制分发，典型用途为云端逐笔历史数据服务）；本次未找到官方原文明确给出Delayed Data具体延时时长
data_latency.en: Market data is licensed in three latency tiers: Real Time Data (via redistribution licences to Professional Customers/Private Investors), Delayed Data (via a 'Delayed / After Midnight Redistribution licence' delivered through controlled mechanisms), and After Midnight Data (via a 'Historical Redistribution licence' delivered through uncontrolled mechanisms, typically used for cloud-based tick history services); no primary source found this session states the specific delay duration for Delayed Data
data_latency.detail:
与market_data_levels共用同一批来源文档，但两个字段描述的是数据的两个不同维度（深度
vs 时效性），故分开成两个独立字段各自摘引quote，不合并。市面上常见"延时数据15分钟"
的说法（在若干第三方与LSEG集团数据业务综合介绍页面中出现过），但本次抓取范围内的
LSE官方定价/政策文档均未见对"15分钟"这一具体时长的逐字确认，按铁律不采纳未落实
原文的印象，故zh/en均不写入这个数字，只如实说明"未找到官方原文明确时长"。

data_latency.quote: 3.1.1 REAL TIME REDISTRIBUTION LICENCES／3.1.2 DELAYED AND AFTER MIDNIGHT REDISTRIBUTION LICENCES／Delayed Data / After Midnight Redistribution licence — A licence for redistribution of Delayed Data and / or After Midnight Data delivered via controlled mechanisms respectively／Historical Redistribution licence — A licence for redistribution of After Midnight Data delivered via uncontrolled mechanisms／Typical use case: Cloud-based tick service, delivery of After Midnight Data via datafeed

data_pricing_model.zh: 按客户类型（专业客户 vs 私人投资者）、数据深度（Level 2/Level 1/盘后）与时效性（实时/延时/收市后）多维度分级定价，年度许可费按客户/计量单位/数据产品逐项累计收取（不含增值税），预先按年开票；数据使用费（Data Charges）按月开票、按月后付。举例：UK market Data（英股整体行情）实时再分发许可，专业客户Level 2年费£67,611、Level 1年费£37,083；私人投资者档Level 2年费£13,258、Level 1年费£8,215；延时数据（Delayed Data）按「企业级」许可另设费率，如UK market Data Level 2企业级年费£158,981
data_pricing_model.en: Pricing is tiered along multiple axes — customer type (Professional vs Private Investor), data depth (Level 2/Level 1/post-trade) and latency (real-time/delayed/after-midnight). Licence Charges are cumulative per Customer, per Unit of Count, per Data Product, quoted excluding VAT and invoiced annually in advance; Data Charges are invoiced monthly in arrears. Example: for UK market Data real-time redistribution, Professional Users pay £67,611/year for Level 2 and £37,083/year for Level 1; the Private Investors tier pays £13,258/year for Level 2 and £8,215/year for Level 1; Delayed Data carries separate 'Enterprise' tier pricing, e.g. £158,981/year for UK market Data Level 2 Enterprise

implicit_costs_note.zh: 买卖价差（隐性成本的主要构成之一）在报价驱动品种上受交易所规则直接约束：注册做市商提供的可执行报价（Executable Quote）买卖价差须不小于一个最小报价单位（tick size），且不得超过就该证券设定的「最大价差百分比」（超出上限的报价会被系统拒绝，除非窄于「最大价差下限」）；具体的最大价差百分比数值定义在未抓取的Business Parameters文档内（与tick_size字段面临的数据缺口相同）
implicit_costs_note.en: Bid-ask spread — one of the main components of implicit trading cost — is directly constrained by Exchange rules for quote-driven instruments: a registered market maker's Executable Quote spread must be at least one tick size and no wider than a security-specific 'maximum spread percentage' (quotes exceeding this ceiling are rejected by the system, unless narrower than the maximum spread floor); the specific maximum-spread percentage values are defined in the Business Parameters document, which was not fetched this session — the same gap already noted for the tick_size field

implicit_costs_note.quote: Executable Quote maximum spread／The spread between the bid and offer prices must be at least one tick size and subject to the maximum spread floor no more than the maximum spread percentage specified for the relevant security. When validating maximum spreads, the absolute spread (offer less bid) is divided by the mid-price of the spread (offer plus bid, divided by two) to determine a percentage spread, which is assessed against the permitted maximum. Executable Quotes that are wider than the permitted maximum spread will be rejected unless it is less than the maximum spread floor. Details of the maximum spread percentage and maximum spread floor in place are contained in the Business Parameters document.

liquidity_risk_note.zh: LSE现货市场的流动性风险呈明显分层：主板核心蓝筹（如富时100成分股，属最高流动性梯队FE10）采用较窄的价格监控阈值（动态3%），流动性次一级的梯队（如FS10）阈值放宽至5%，反映交易所自身在制度设计上已确认不同证券的流动性/波动特征存在数量级差异（见price_limits.main_board）；订单驱动品种以外，流动性较低的品种（含部分AIM证券）改用报价驱动的SETSqx机制、依赖注册做市商的确定报价（Firm Quotes）维持可交易性，而非依赖自然订单簿深度（见market_maker_scheme）——两种机制并存本身即是「部分证券依赖做市商托底流动性」的结构性证据
liquidity_risk_note.en: Liquidity risk on LSE's cash markets is clearly tiered: the most liquid segment (e.g. FTSE 100 constituents, LSE sector FE10) uses a narrower dynamic price-monitoring threshold (3%), while a less liquid tier (e.g. FS10) uses a wider 5% threshold — the Exchange's own rule design already reflects an order-of-magnitude difference in liquidity/volatility characteristics across securities (see price_limits.main_board). Beyond order-driven instruments, less liquid names (including some AIM securities) instead use the quote-driven SETSqx mechanism, relying on registered market makers' Firm Quotes to sustain tradability rather than natural order-book depth (see market_maker_scheme) — the coexistence of the two mechanisms is itself structural evidence that liquidity for some securities depends on market-maker backstops

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 压测点核心字段——英国脱欧后正处于持续的监管框架重构期，三条并行证据：(1) 2024年7月UKLR改革以单一“股票证券（商业公司）”类别取代此前承接自欧盟体系的Premium/Standard两级上市架构；(2) 2026年7月13日起，SSR 2025正式取代此前“承接”的欧盟《卖空条例》(EU) No 236/2012；(3) 英国计划于2027年10月11日整体切换至T+1结算周期（现行仍为T+2），与欧盟是否/何时跟进尚不同步。三条改革叠加意味着填写本文件时必须持续关注“规则是否已生效”而非套用脱欧前的欧盟框架惯例
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Core stress-test field — post-Brexit, the UK is in a sustained period of regulatory reconstruction, evidenced by three parallel threads: (1) the July 2024 UKLR reform replaced the previously EU-derived two-tier Premium/Standard listing structure with a single 'equity shares (commercial companies)' category; (2) from 13 July 2026, SSR 2025 formally replaced the previously-assimilated EU Short Selling Regulation (EU) No 236/2012; (3) the UK plans a market-wide move to T+1 settlement on 11 October 2027 (currently still T+2), not necessarily synchronised with if/when the EU follows. Together these mean data in this file must be checked against 'has this rule actually taken effect' rather than assumed to follow pre-Brexit EU-framework conventions

enforcement_note.zh: 英国市场滥用监管框架（UK MAR）——2016年7月生效的欧盟《市场滥用条例》经2020年12月31日「内化」（onshored）为英国国内法后持续演进（2021年《金融服务法》就董事内部人名单/管理层交易另有修订）。内幕交易、非法披露、市场操纵及操纵未遂构成UK MAR下的民事违规，FCA可处以无上限罚款、责令禁令、禁止相关机构/获批人员从业；刑事层面，内幕交易依《1993年刑事司法法》第五编、市场操纵依《2012年金融服务法》第89-91条定罪，最高可判10年监禁并处无上限罚金
enforcement_note.en: The UK Market Abuse Regulation (UK MAR) regime — the EU Market Abuse Regulation, effective 3 July 2016, was onshored into UK domestic law on 31 December 2020 and has continued to evolve (e.g. amendments on insider lists and managers' transactions under the Financial Services Act 2021). Insider dealing, unlawful disclosure, market manipulation and attempted manipulation are civil offences under UK MAR, for which the FCA can impose unlimited fines, order injunctions, and prohibit firms or approved persons from operating; criminally, insider dealing is an offence under Part V of the Criminal Justice Act 1993 and market manipulation under sections 89-91 of the Financial Services Act 2012, carrying custodial sentences of up to 10 years plus unlimited fines
enforcement_note.detail:
与risks.investor_protection（FSCS对投资中介倒闭的事后补偿）是不同角度：本字段
聚焦"市场公平性/操纵行为"的监管执法体系，FSCS聚焦"机构倒闭"的投资者事后救济，

enforcement_note.quote: Market Abuse Regulation (MAR) The EU Market Abuse Regulation (EU MAR) came into effect on 3 July 2016 and was onshored into UK law on 31 December 2020 by the EU (Withdrawal) Act 2018.／The following are civil offences under UK MAR: Insider dealing. Unlawful disclosure. Market manipulation. Attempted manipulation.／Criminal insider dealing is an offence under Part V of the Criminal Justice Act 1993. Criminal market manipulation is an offence under sections 89 to 91 of the Financial Services Act 2012.／For breaches of UK MAR we can: Impose unlimited fines. Order injunctions. Prohibit regulated firms or approved persons. Criminal sanctions for insider dealing and market manipulation can incur custodial sentences of up to 10 years and unlimited fines.
